Introduction
This document was produced in 2002. This document describes the test procedure, denoted by the letter I1, for testing the directional overcurrent protection device on 132 kV circuits, which is carried out every year, denoted by the letter Y1, in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and acquired experience, in order to provide safety factors for personnel and to maintain the safe operation of the protection device.
Safety precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority
Open the circuit breaker of the circuit on which the device is to be tested.
Isolate the circuit breaker control supply
Check the device test certificate to find out the required setting values.
